description:
Altitude: 1234 m, Elevation Gain: 1000 m, Total Distance of Trail Network: +/-100 km.

Kelowna Snowmobile Club
directions: Travel Time: +/-1 hour from Kelowna. From Hwy 97 take Hwy 33 south for 22 km past the Joe Rich Valley and Philpott Rd to Three Forks Rd. There are several access points. Turn left on Three Forks Rd and drive 28km until you reach Graystoke Lake. Park in the parking area past the snowmobile chalet by Long Lake. Another section can be accessed off the 2010 Spirit Trail east of Hydraulic Lake where it splits from the McCulloch Snowmobile trail to the right.
title: Graystokes Snowmobile Trails
